proposals.title: FIRST STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Scott M. Stringer, Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of the New York City Employees' Retirement System, the New York City Police Pension Fund, and the New York City Board of Education Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt and enforce a policy requiring annual public disclosure of EEO-1 workforce data broken down by race and gender across 10 employment categories, beginning in 2018.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the first stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: SECOND STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL - Transparent Political Spending
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of James McRitchie
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semiannually updated report disclosing the company's political campaign policies, and contributions and expenditures including trade association payments, with recipients, amounts and decision-makers.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the second stockholder proposal.
